name: Bard Catrìona

intro.text: A bard keeps the songs: who left, who stayed, who was cleared off which glen. I'll sing you one after. First, let's see your mettle.

win: Math fhèin! Very good indeed. Come in to the frolic.
after: Gaelic songs carried the memory of the Clearances and the crossing: there are songs of longing for the old country, and songs of praise for the new.
